evals.prompt: pick up the next auto-dev issue and build it, open a PR but don't merge
evals.expected_output: Selects the lowest-numbered ready auto-dev issue via auto_issue_dev.sh next-issue, branches with the issue-number prefix, implements test-first, verifies, and opens a (non-draft) PR that the #345 hook links with Closes #N. Stops at PR-open; never merges.

evals.prompt: run the autonomous issue developer until there's nothing left in the queue
evals.expected_output: Explains it develops one issue per invocation and is driven unattended via /loop /auto-issue-dev, terminating when next-issue exits 3 (empty queue), reporting how many issues were skipped as dependency-blocked.

evals.prompt: auto-develop issue work but if something has an unmerged dependency, don't touch it
evals.expected_output: Notes that next-issue auto-detects unmet dependencies (depends on/blocked by/requires/needs #M), tags those issues blocked-dependency, comments naming the blocker, and excludes them from the loop scope rather than developing them.
